educationLevel.title: Education level
educationLevel.description: The user's current or target education level.

fieldOfStudy.title: Field of study
fieldOfStudy.description: e.g. Computer Science, Public Health, Economics

fundingNeeded.title: Needs funding
fundingNeeded.description: Whether the student needs full or partial funding.

cvText.title: CV content (optional)
cvText.description: Plain text of the student's CV. When provided, ambiguous eligibility criteria (e.g. 'research experience preferred') are checked against real CV content instead of left unconfirmed. Extract text from a PDF/DOCX before sending, this field expects plain text, not a file.
